zoe-sre: FYI regional lockdown config applied to us-east. GPU allocator reporting high pending joins, 5/12 nodes stuck trying to pull keystore grants.

maria-sec: Which error? kms or firewall?

zoe-sre: Node log: `2026-03-25T22:00:02Z WARN join: grant verify fail: kms:NotFound; http: 403 from keystore-proxy`

audit-bot: shipper: GET /us-east/keystore/verify 403 (keystore policy)

khaled-ml: One of our large embeddings jobs timed out on first try; reschedules will backpressure. Can we get a quick mitigation?

zoe-sre: Options: 1) add keystore-proxy to keystore policy allowlist 2) open temporary firewall for keystore proxy CIDR 3) revert regional lockdown. Thoughts?

maria-sec: Add keystore-proxy ARN to policy is least impact. I'll do that and also add a verification probe.

maria-sec: Running policy patch (internal):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/keystore-us-east --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-proxy --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```

maria-sec: Grant created. Keystore proxies can now perform encrypt/decrypt.

deploy-bot: canary-join run: 12/12 nodes succeeded within 60s.

ops-bot: Pool healthy. Cost normalized.

zoe-sre: Follow-ups: - add probe in deploy CI to run keystore verify from proxy role - document keystore policy checklist before regional lockdowns - schedule a postmortem on canary coverage of keystore edge cases.

khaled-ml: Thanks. I'll hold job restarts to smooth load.

zoe-sre: Closing thread. Marking as resolved.
